content: {"like": ["Louder volume on the Blu‑ray discs", "Inclusion of English subtitles (present on Billy Jack, Born Losers, and Billy Jack Goes to Washington)", "Smoother picture on the Born Losers Blu‑ray compared to the DVD", "Excellent picture quality on Billy Jack Goes to Washington (solid Blu‑ray quality with fine color and sharpness)"], "dislike": ["One of the four discs was missing from the sealed package", "Sub‑par remastering and production quality compared to major studios", "Oversaturated color and occasionally wrong flesh tones on Billy Jack", "Additional grain added to the picture, making it less desirable", "Repetition of the One Tin Soldier audio in the closing credits, which should have been silent", "Shorter running time due to omission of the MPAA rating and addition of a graphic", "Omission of documentaries, trailers, and commentary tracks that were present on earlier releases", "Poor menu design with unchanging stills and intrusive music", "Artifacts, white streaks, and weak picture quality on The Trial of Billy Jack", "Letterbox presentation (2.35:1) on Billy Jack Goes to Washington, which the reviewer does not favor", "Jitter and instability in some scenes of Born Losers", "Overall disappointment with the set and lack of recommendation for purchase unless subtitles are essential"]}
